description: This source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component used to display log information received through the LogNode interface. It formats log entries, handles threading concerns for UI updates, and supports chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages formatted with priority, tag, message, and exceptions. It implements the LogNode interface and supports chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView with various parameter sets to initialize the view.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and appends a log message to the LogView, handling different priority levels and exceptions, updating the UI thread accordingly.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log display.
